chunks: My father (may Allah be pleased with him) narrated, saying: Sa'd ibn Abdullah narrated to me, saying: Abu Muhammad al-Fazl al-Yamani narrated to me, saying: Al-Hasan ibn Jumhur narrated to me, from his father, from Ali ibn Hadid, from Abd al-Rahman ibn al-Hajjaj, from Harun ibn Kharijah, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:

Gabriel descended upon the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) and said: 'O Muhammad, indeed Allah, the Mighty and Majestic, has accepted your intercession on behalf of five: the one who carried you in her womb, which is Aminah bint Wahb ibn Abd al-Muttalib; the one through whom you came from his loins, which is Abd Allah ibn Abd al-Muttalib; the one who cared for you in his lap, which is Abd al-Muttalib ibn Hashim; the one who sheltered you in his house, which is Abd Manaf ibn Abd al-Muttalib, Abu Talib; and a brother who was with you during the pre-Islamic period.' It was said: 'O Messenger of Allah, who is this brother?' He replied: 'He was my companion and I was his companion, and he was generous, feeding people with food.'
The compiler of this book (may Allah be pleased with him) said: 'The name of this brother is al-Jallas ibn Alqamah.'
ai.seo_question: Who are the five persons for whom the Prophet's intercession was accepted according to this hadith?
ai.summary: In this narration from *Al-Khisal*, Shaykh al-Saduq records that Gabriel announced Allah’s acceptance of the Prophet’s intercession for five key relatives, emphasizing the spiritual status of the Prophet’s immediate family (*Ahl al-Bit*) even before their full acceptance of Islam. The inclusion of his mother Aminah and uncle Abu Talib highlights the Shia scholarly view of their righteous standing, while the identification of the 'brother' as al-Jallas (a close companion) underscores the breadth of the Prophet's compassionate intercession. This hadith serves as a foundational text for understanding the concept of *Shafa'ah* (intercession) within the Shia tradition, linking familial piety to divine mercy.

en.dr-ali-peiravi: 5-60 (The compiler of the book narrated) that his father (ra) narrated that Sa’ed ibn Abdullah quoted Abu Muhammad al-Fazl al-Yamani, on the authority of Al-Hassan ibn Jumhoor, on the authority of his father, on the authority of Ali ibn Hadid, on the authority of Abdul Rahman ibn al-Haj’jaj, on the authority of Harun ibn Kharijah that Aba Abdullah as-Sadiq (AS) said,

“Gabriel descended upon the Messenger of Allah (sw) and said: ‘O Muhammad, indeed Allah, the Mighty and Majestic, has accepted your intercession on behalf of five: the one who carried you in her womb, Āmina bint Wahb ibn ‘Abd Manāf; the one through whom you came from his loins, ‘Abdullāh ibn ‘Abd al-Muṭṭalib; the one who cared for you, ‘Abd al-Muṭṭalib ibn Hāshim; the one who sheltered you in his house, ‘Abū Ṭālib, ‘Abd Manāf ibn ‘Abd al-Muṭṭalib; and a brother who was with you during the pre-Islamic period.’ He was asked, ‘O Messenger of Allah, who was this brother?’ He replied, ‘He was my companion, and I was his, generous and charitable in feeding others.’
The compiler of this book (ra) said: ‘The name of this brother was al-Julās ibn ‘Alqamah.’”
